description:
Consolidates deferred live integration test work from completed platform
adapter TODOs. Each adapter was implemented with full unit test coverage but
deferred live cloud testing due to account provisioning requirements.

Platforms with deferred live tests:
- Firebolt Cloud (from firebolt-cloud-deployment)
- StarRocks (from starrocks-olap-platform)
- Starburst Galaxy (from starburst-platform-adapter)
- MotherDuck (from motherduck-platform-adapter)
- pg_duckdb via MotherDuck (from pg-duckdb-platform-adapter)
- pg_mooncake object storage (from pg-mooncake-platform-adapter)

Also consolidates deferred CI infrastructure items:
- Docker-based PostgreSQL extension testing (from postgres-extension-benchmarking-infrastructure)
- Automated multi-extension comparison pipeline

MotherDuck adapter feature work (credential wizard, cloud upload, cache
control) has been split to motherduck-cloud-features.yaml - this TODO covers
only test infrastructure and smoke tests.

work_units.notes:
Produce a provisioning checklist covering:
1. Which accounts already exist (check for env vars / config files)
2. Minimum viable setup per platform (free tier? trial? Docker alternative?)
   - StarRocks: Docker Compose (free, local) - already has docker/starrocks/
   - pg_duckdb / pg_mooncake: Docker (free, local)
   - MotherDuck: free tier available (10 GB)
   - Firebolt: trial account required
   - Starburst Galaxy: trial account required
3. Required env vars per platform for skip-when-unavailable logic
4. Estimated monthly cost for platforms without free tiers
5. Recommendation: prioritize Docker-based tests (free) first, then
   free-tier cloud, then paid-tier cloud
Decision: Docker-based tests (w7) should run in CI from the start since
they are free and deterministic. Cloud tests remain local-only until
credentials are available in CI secrets.
work_units.summary: Research - inventory cloud accounts, document provisioning steps, estimate costs

work_units.notes:
Register new markers (live_firebolt, live_starburst, live_motherduck,
live_pg_duckdb, live_pg_mooncake) in pyproject.toml.
Add a shared fixture or helper for the standard smoke test pattern:
connect → create table → load SF=0.01 → run TPC-H Q1 → validate row count.
work_units.summary: Add per-platform live test markers to pyproject.toml and create shared cloud test fixtures
